images.lesson_for_care_ase: Treat MoSAIC as a read-only benchmark and source of pathology-specific authority; no ensemble, teacher, selector, copied weights or Cine path enters CARE-ASE.

images.name: CARE-ASE
observed_design: one stock-compatible full-volume encoder/bottleneck/shared low-mid decoder
three independent highest-two-scale paths for anatomy, scar and edema
T2-driven full-volume edema reconstruction with injury, boundary, slice extent and dilation context
conditional final competition: six classes with T2 and five classes excluding edema without T2
three mandatory stages totaling 14000 optimizer steps
explicitly_absent_from_figure: hard ROI or hard wall transform
images.planner_interpretation: This figure is the primary visual architecture authority. The implementation must preserve direct branch ownership, real final-logit interventions and row-wise no-T2 graph exclusion rather than merely naming these modules.

cross_figure_frozen_synthesis: CARE-ASE is not another residual correction system: stock nnU-Net supplies a complete initialized trunk, while new scar and edema branches directly own class-5 and class-4 logits.
Scar and pure edema have different information and morphology contracts; LGE/T2 authority, branch topology, targets, sampling and negative spaces remain distinct.
Anatomy geometry is soft detached context, never a hard gate.
The no-T2 rule is computational and semantic: edema-owned modules are not called for absent rows, all edema losses/gradients are zero, and class 4 is removed from final competition.
Historical methods are benchmarks and failure evidence only; no deprecated mechanism may be silently restored.
